question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Apple guided Sep-quarter FY26 revenue +9-11% YoY on $102.47B base => $111.7-113.7B, with 2.5pt FX headwind and significantly tighter iPhone supply constraints. calls.reconciliation: No web access; reconciled from the dossiers only. Facts (guidance, base, consensus, report date, track record) are consistent across all runs. The main dispute is the probability of landing below $112B (16% vs 6%), which is judgment over a shared record: one miss below the guided low end in four quarters, but this quarter has heavier FX and supply headwinds. I set it at 9%. The median disagreement (113.8-114.0B) is small; 113.9B reflects Apple's typical ~0.5% beat over consensus. Above-upper tail at 2%: 15%+ growth under binding supply limits is very unlikely. Dispersion is similar to the runs' 3.1-3.6B width.
